summary: The perf-slot wrapper installs its signal handlers before it publishes the holder record, so Ctrl-C or SIGTERM right after the slot is taken stops the run and drops the record

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: A SIGINT that came between the holder record and the handlers exited 130 and left holder.json naming a dead run; a SIGTERM there killed the wrapper outright. Both now reach the watchdog. ci-perf-slot-test signals as soon as the record appears, which failed 10 of 10 runs on a build host against the old order (it is a race detector: how often it catches the window depends on scheduling).

downtime.detail: Takes effect on the next run of the wrapper.

recovery.detail: Reverting brings back the window and the test's merge-group failures.
